children: US protective apparel maker's fiscal Q2 sales fell 4.5% yr/yr, missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA excluding FX more than doubled sequentially but declined yr/yr
Company saw margin improvement from favorable Fire Products mix and net tariff refund
Company expects margin performance to continue improving in the second half of fiscal 2027
Lakeland Industries aims to convert demand and backlog into revenue and maintain expense discipline
Company anticipates a return to more consistent growth in the second half, with quarter-to-quarter variability
FIRE PRODUCTS DEMAND - Revenue from Fire Products rose 2% yr/yr and 12% sequentially, with strong demand for turnout gear, helmets and hoods as customers transitioned to updated NFPA standards
FIRE SERVICES EXPANSION - Fire Services revenue increased 78% yr/yr as co expanded its service footprint with new and expanded locations
INDUSTRIAL REVENUE DECLINE - Industrial revenue fell 10.8% on a reported basis, but excluding divested product lines, increased about 3%
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Lakeland Industries Inc is $17.00, about 47.7% above its September 8 closing price of $11.51
The stock recently traded at 42 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 69 three months ago
